meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会借助 orca computer 检查并向本机可见的应用窗口发送输入,覆盖原生应用、外部浏览器窗口(Chrome、Edge 等)和应用内嵌网页。运行前它会选定本次会话的 Orca 可执行文件并加载版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当任务需要在本机可见窗口里做系统/窗口级的检查与输入时触发,例如原生应用、外部浏览器窗口、应用内嵌网页。Orca 内嵌浏览器和纯页面自动化不走它。

say.text: 用 orca computer 看看我当前打开的窗口里有什么
say.note: 会先加载版本匹配的指南再操作

say.text: 在这个本地应用的窗口里帮我点一下、输入文字
say.note: 只作用于可见的本地窗口

say.text: 先在 Chrome 外部窗口里找到那个按钮的位置
say.note: Chrome 属于支持的外部浏览器窗口

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude inspects and sends input to visible local app windows via `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. It first resolves the session's Orca executable and loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs OS/window-level inspection or input in visible local windows. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

say_en.text: Use orca computer to show me what's in the windows I have open
In this local app window, click that and type text for me
say_en.note: Applies only to visible local windows

say_en.text: Find the position of that button in my Chrome window
say_en.note: Chrome is a supported external browser window
